value.rationale: This is the full F11 Weil-isogeny classification of a natural dihedral genus-four family in the first split prime. It distinguishes five natural arithmetic moduli strata with an exceptional elliptic-fourth-power Jacobian, and determines the full geometric Hasse divisor and its Frobenius splitting; these are invariants not fixed by the classical group classification or square-isogeny framework.
